notes.title: UPDATE 1.1
notes.content:
Update 1.1 is now here! This update includes bug fixes as well as graphic upgrades.

Bug Fixes
- Ants deleting
      - Ants will now relocate to the nearest nest or hub ONLY if one is near.
- Ants "escaping" ants that glitch out of the nest will slowly slide back into the nearest nest or hub.

Upgraded Features!
- New background to the "Main Menu" and "Start Colony" screens
- Reorganized "How to Play" screen provides more detailed instructions as well as a "visual" button linked with a visual tutorial.
- New Food Icons:
      Candy (Random Colors)
      Chicken
      Honey
      Apple
      Strawberry

With these updated features My Little Colony will be making further steps into providing a high quality experience! Thank you again for your support and patience. We hope you enjoy this update and continue to join us on our journey.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 1.0 IS HERE![/h1]

[h2]Major Bug Fixes:[/h2]

- Ant escaping tubes
- Ant behavioral patterns
- Building connections
- Deselection issues
- Saving errors
- Unusable objects
- Updated menus and main screen

[h2]Added Features:[/h2]

- [b]Music radios![/b]
  ~ Happiness radio
  ~ Jazz radio
  ~ Weather Radio
  ~ World radio
- [b]New ant species![/b]
  ~ Fire ants
  ~ Weaver ants
- [b]New food items[/b]
  ~ Honey
  ~ Chicken
  ~ Honey
  ~ Candy
  ~ Sugar water
- How to play menu
- "Esc" key deletes objects
- Wider screen space
- "W, A, S, D" now moves around the screen

Thank you for your patience! After reading our google form and communicating with our audience we now have UPDATE 1.0! This update not only rebuilds the foundation of the game to be more informative to the player but also eliminates the bugs we had from before. This update will be a foundation for what is to come in the following year. We hope that this update will improve your ant-keeping experience to be better than before. If there are any new bugs and issues, do not hesitate to contact us on our google form so we may solve them. As well as any new ideas you'd love to see in the game! Thank you again for your patience we hope to bring more to you soon!

notes.title: Thank you
notes.content: Hello everyone. We understand the current state of the game and we have read every review and email about this game. We will start off my saying sorry for the games current condition. Our team has been limited on the time spent working on the game so far. However here is the good news. This summer our team will be working full swing on My Little Colony! We know its potential and want to fully explore it as there is so much we have envisioned for the game. Our team has already put in tons of time this last month to get the game rolling again. We will be releasing an update with full details in the next couple weeks informing you on what the update will contain but for now we just wanted thank you for supporting us thus far. We hope that what we have been working on will bring you the game you all deserve. Thank you again.

notes.title: My Little Colony Coming Soon
notes.content:
Coming Soon to Steam [b]My Little Colony[/b], were players play as an aspiring ant keeper. My little colony is a 2D ant simulator game which uses game play elements such as simple clicking and dragging actions to build your colony. Players will get to relax and sit while watching their colony grow to ensure players are at ease while your colony does all the work! You will get to choose your colony from Black ants to Fire ants and more. Build and connect more ant setups in thousands of different combinations, only limited by your imagination, around your room to expand your colony. But make sure your queen has all the food and water she needs to keep the colony growing! Good luck! 

You as a player will get to start by selecting which ant species you like. Once selected your desk can now start holding your colony. As the colony progresses you will need to buy and store food for your ants as well as build more nests and homes for your ants. Over time your colony will grow and expand in size. As well as the need for maintenance. But don't worry with the use of food and build menus you will quickly get a hold of what its like to have your own ant colony!
